concerns.text: FR-004 (Spec) mandates 'shuffling group labels' for Type I error, but the Plan and T024a implement 'simulated null data'. While the Plan corrects the methodology, the tasks lack a explicit task to update FR-004 in the spec or a task to document this deviation. The implementer has no task to resolve the spec/plan contradiction.

FR-008 (Spec) mandates 'Friedman test', but the Plan and T041a implement 'GLMM'. Similar to FR-004, there is no task to update the spec requirement or document the methodological correction. The implementer cannot satisfy the written FR-008 without violating the Plan.

FR-010 requires checksums for 'all downloaded datasets' (raw). T014 only checksums 'retained datasets in data/filtered/'. There is no task to checksum the raw downloaded files before filtering, violating the spec's data integrity requirement.

FR-001 requires recording 'explicit dataset URLs' in data/datasets.csv. T013b validates URLs but lacks a task to explicitly write them to the CSV. T017 mentions metadata extraction but does not explicitly mandate writing the URL column to satisfy FR-001.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksums for 'Every file under data/'. T015a and T016a define schemas for imputation/exclusion logs, but no task exists to checksum these generated log files, violating the Constitution.
Task T015a and T016a are duplicated in Phase 2 and Phase 3 with conflicting IDs (T015a vs T015a, T016a vs T016a). This creates ambiguity in execution order and task tracking.

Task T015a in Phase 3 references 'T015 (Imputation)' as a dependency, but T015 is marked as '[~]' (incomplete/defer) while T015a is '[X]' (complete). The dependency chain is broken or logically inconsistent.
